request.purpose: We want to compare how often the recommended drugs are used in different age groups, to update a teaching module for GPs.
request.question: Provide pseudonymised encounter records of patients with heart failure.
definitions: Heart failure stay = inpatient stay whose main diagnosis (primary_icd10) starts with I50.
Count stays (not patients) whose start_date is in 2025.
Report per sex: heart failure stays.
